gaps.quote: which restores its [scratch storage](scratch-storage.md) to its starting contents, whatever they were
gaps.note: The claim that the network returns scratch storage to its starting contents whatever they were is asserted, not shown from what the page gives.

gaps.quote: So the data changes do not depend on the scratch starting values
gaps.note: The sentence is cut off by a colon, the attribution to the source gives no argument, and the displayed formula is missing, so the claim is unsupported.

gaps.quote: Each child works on $V/W$ bits, since
gaps.note: The 'since' has no following clause, so the reason each child works on V/W bits is not given.

gaps.quote: so its work is proportional to $V(s/W)^j$
gaps.note: Assumes that a call's own work is proportional to its volume and that total work is the sum over levels. Neither is stated, and the page states the bound as time, not work.
